title: Threat Triage Assistant: Cutting Through SOC Alert Fatigue

coherence.message: The ARM template deploys microsoft.authorization/roleassignments, microsoft.managedidentity/userassignedidentities, microsoft.insights/datacollectionendpoints, but the custom RBAC role's Actions never allow these providers/types — the deployment can fail with an authorization error. Add "microsoft.authorization/roleassignments/write", "microsoft.managedidentity/userassignedidentities/write", "microsoft.insights/datacollectionendpoints/write" (or the provider wildcard, e.g. "microsoft.authorization/*") to the role's Actions.

"Validations/Validate-Challenge-01-UnifiedDetection.ps1" requires resource types the deployment templates never create: Microsoft.Insights/dataCollectionRules, Microsoft.SecurityInsights/alertRules, Microsoft.SecurityInsights/incidents, Microsoft.SecurityInsights/incidents/comments. A correctly-deployed lab can never pass this validator — either deploy the resource or rewrite the check against what the template actually provisions.

"Validations/Validate-Challenge-02-Investigation.ps1" requires resource types the deployment templates never create: Microsoft.SecurityInsights/incidents, Microsoft.SecurityInsights/incidents/comments, Microsoft.SecurityInsights/bookmarks, Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/savedSearches. A correctly-deployed lab can never pass this validator — either deploy the resource or rewrite the check against what the template actually provisions.

"Validations/Validate-Challenge-03-AutomatedResponse.ps1" requires resource types the deployment templates never create: Microsoft.Logic/workflows, Microsoft.SecurityInsights/automationRules, Microsoft.Network/networkSecurityGroups/securityRules, Microsoft.SecurityInsights/incidents/comments. A correctly-deployed lab can never pass this validator — either deploy the resource or rewrite the check against what the template actually provisions.

"Validations/Validate-Challenge-04-TuneAndReport.ps1" requires resource types the deployment templates never create: Microsoft.Insights/workbooks, Microsoft.Network/networkSecurityGroups/securityRules/write, Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/, Microsoft.SecurityInsights/alertRules. A correctly-deployed lab can never pass this validator — either deploy the resource or rewrite the check against what the template actually provisions.

The template deploys a virtual machine but no auto-shutdown schedule — the VM keeps billing after the session ends. Add a Microsoft.DevTestLab/schedules resource per VM (taskType "ComputeVmShutdownTask", name "shutdown-computevm-<vmName>") with a dailyRecurrence time.
